scene.speaker: ingrid
scene.bubble: Mission: cross the whole city in one hour using four kinds of transport. Ready, Diego?
scene.intro: Mission: cross the whole city in one hour using four kinds of transport! Ingrid and Diego go by tram to the centre, by bicycle along the river, by train from the platform at ten past four, and finally by taxi because they are late. They never touch the motorway, which Diego says is cheating anyway. Fifty-eight minutes — mission accomplished. How do you get to school? By bus, by bike, on foot? Plan your own city mission!

data.voice_note: Voces: Ingrid (capitana) y Diego (narrando en vivo).
data.script: Diego: The mission starts at the school gate! First we go by bicycle to the river. … Ingrid: Ten minutes, well done. Now the tram — platform two! … Diego: The tram is green and very full. We stand next to a man with a big dog. … Ingrid: Next: we walk over the old bridge and take a taxi. … Diego: Our taxi driver is called Pedro. There's a lot of traffic on the motorway! … Ingrid: Last part — the boat across the bay! … Diego: We arrive at the lighthouse in fifty-eight minutes. Mission complete!
